name: axHub apps
author: Brett
description: The hub's app catalog inside the console: every app the framework's CI has built, with the latest build, earlier builds, sizes, times and a download link each (the download is the hub's own path, so the hub decides who may), read through the console's hub-pages relay. Module axHub (the hub's own pages inside the console, folded from apps/axhub-web Nov 20 2026). Only a wall admin's browser may use it; uninstalling it removes only these pages.
